clause.quote: The size component MUST count the Quadlets/triplets in its following group.

description: A -J group of size 10 (40 characters) holding a 44-character D key: the group ends four characters before the key does, and those four characters then sit at the top level where no frame can start. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a group whose size ends it inside a primitive
